title: [ingest] Autowire defaults to 0.55 unless overridden
summary: Semantic note-wiring uses `0.55` by default, but the daemon will honor `ORCH_AUTOWIRE_THRESHOLD` when present. Bench daemons deliberately lower this to surface the full reranked pool, while production keeps the cutoff.
